title: Arrangement Term in Months for Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease TRAC Deficiencies
content:
# Arrangement Terms Clause — Number of Arrangement Months, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Clause.** For a Kestrel payment arrangement on a TRAC deficiency of a Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease unit, the arrangement months are counted as follows: where the unit was turned in before its scheduled end date and the business holds an active Kestrel Advantage Balloon contract with no days past due, they are the whole months from today to the unit's scheduled end date, never more than 12 and never fewer than 1, so a scheduled end date already passed gives 1; where the unit was turned in before its scheduled end date and the business holds no active balloon contract with no days past due, they are a fixed 3; otherwise they are 1.

**Records read.** The unit's turn-in date and scheduled end date; whether the business holds a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract whose status is active and whose days past due are zero.

**Counting.** "Turned in before its scheduled end date" means a turn-in date on an earlier calendar day than the scheduled end date (days between two dates count the later date but not the earlier one). Whole months from today to the scheduled end date are counted from the earlier date to the later one, are one fewer where the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's, and are negative where the later date comes first.

## Branch table

| Turn-in before scheduled end date | Active balloon contract with zero days past due | Arrangement months |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | whole months from today to the scheduled end date, at most 12 and at least 1 |
| Yes | No | 3 |
| No (on or after the scheduled end date) | any | 1 |

## Cases (hypothetical, first row unless stated)

1. Today the 10th of a month, scheduled end date the 25th of the month seven months later: 7 months.
2. Scheduled end date the 5th of that month instead: 6 months.
3. Scheduled end date 20 months away: 12 months, the most.
4. Scheduled end date already passed: the whole months are negative, so 1.
5. Turned in before its scheduled end date, no active balloon contract with zero days past due: 3 months.
6. Turned in on its scheduled end date: 1 month.
